project: No Good News / Some Good News — Global Media Sentiment & Story Cluster API

clusters.description: Cross-outlet story clusters with neutral headlines, editorial summaries, single-word topic tags, lead images, valence spread, and per-outlet coverage links.

goodNews.description: Rescued constructive breakthroughs (sentiment >= +0.15) including the Daily 5 Antidote, constructive multi-outlet clusters, and 24h/7d positive dispatches.

outlets.description: 40-outlet global newsroom sentiment leaderboard, regional groupings, historical baselines, and topic × outlet sentiment matrix.

timeseries.description: Rolling historical sentiment trajectory snapshots across global and individual newsroom averages.

summary.description: Lightweight 24h dashboard payload combining global stats, story clusters, and recent outlet dispatches.

fullArchive.description: Complete multi-day archive of all analyzed articles across all 40 global newsrooms.
